title: Recorded UIforETW intraline emphasis
reference_disclaimer: These are deterministic captures from commit ff75096 using the real recorded google/UIforETW#74 Files-drawer selection path. All runs use Qt 6.11.1 offscreen QFusionStyle at device pixel ratio 1. Judge only the visible intraline-emphasis criterion. Native operating-system appearance integration, BPR-0220 geometry-rebuild attribution, BPR-0210 remediation, RFC closeout, and release readiness are outside this batch.

subjects.display_name: Do the recorded replacement rows visibly identify the characters that changed in all four profiles?
subjects.description: The selected UIforETW.rc comparison contains two near-identical replacement pairs: 464,28 becomes 464,24 and 464,42 becomes 464,36. Whole-line red and green bands identify changed lines; the narrower role-coloured marks must identify the differing digits without drifting to another row or disappearing. Review the same exact blobs in Light, Dark, High-contrast Light, and High-contrast Dark.
acceptance_criteria: Each removed replacement row has a narrow intraline-removed mark distinct from its whole-line removed band
Each added replacement row has a narrow intraline-added mark distinct from its whole-line added band
The narrow marks align with the changed coordinate digits rather than another row or unrelated text
The emphasis remains visibly distinguishable in Light, Dark, High-contrast Light, and High-contrast Dark
known_concerns: The captures are offscreen QFusionStyle evidence, not a claim about native macOS, Windows, or Linux styling.
Long resource-script lines are horizontally clipped by the comparison pane; the changed coordinate region is deliberately centered and visible.
The deterministic course proves exact commits, blobs, pairs, role assignments, and a cut-wire negative. This decision is only the human visual judgement of the resulting pixels.

audit_verdict.note: The registered product contract passed four exact-profile captures and a fifth run with the real Qt selection wire cut. It required three named replacement pairs across Resource.h and UIforETW.rc, exact base/head blobs, non-full-width removed/added role selections, and zero fixture-diff helper invocations.
